title: Verify evidence and wire the repeat-proposal gate (VC-201-019)
goal: VC-201-019 refuted: check_proposal treats ANY non-empty fresh_receipts list — including a single empty string — as 'new evidence'; the counterexample cap truncates newest entries so fresh rejections stop being learned; and check_proposal has no production caller so 'a repeated proposal is refused' is never enforced. The parallel ExperimentMemory is worse: repeats are keyed by caller-chosen proposal_id (identical content under a new id is Fresh) and may_resubmit accepts caller booleans. Evidence: crates/susi-gawd/src/tests/vc_201_019_mastery.rs.
